description: Search the sourced club directory for country, city, yacht and hybrid clubs. Returns membership/access notes, reciprocity, facilities, official links, sources and verification dates. Use club_type=golf to find directory clubs whose verified facilities mention golf. This is club discovery, not a golf-course ranking; use find_golf_courses for the ranked course shortlist. "Unknown" network status does not mean "not listed."

city.description: Only clubs whose city contains these words, e.g. "Bogota".

club_type.description: Only this club type; golf matches clubs whose verified facilities mention golf.

country.description: Only clubs in this country. Country name or slug, e.g. "Panama" or "costa-rica".

limit.description: How many clubs to return. Defaults to 50.

query.description: Words to match in the club name, city, facilities or notes.

name: find_private_clubs
title: Find private clubs in Latin America
